W.note: Axis-aligned boxes only, so nothing rotates or tips and stacks look flat; the throw just keeps the lagging chase velocity and the HUD text is the only guidance.

X.note: Rotated SAT boxes with sequential impulses, substeps, a spring grab and release velocity give believable tipping piles and throws, with a clean dark grid look and a clear hint, though the mobile hint text clips into a box.

Y.note: Same solid rotated-box approach with contact manifolds and a spring grab, settling into convincing stacks, but the only control is Reset and the visuals are plainer.

Z.note: Direct pointer tracking and clear Add box, Gravity and Reset controls, but upright AABB-only physics and a dragged body that shoves neighbours hard make the piles less believable.
